chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Jamil ibn Salih from Abu Basir said:

I heard a man saying to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): 'May I be your ransom, I am a man who has grown old, and I have married a young virgin girl, but I have not yet entered (consummated) with her. And I fear that when she enters upon me and sees me, she will dislike me because of my henna-dyed hair and my old age.'

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'When she is brought to you, if God wills, tell them before she reaches you that she should be in a state of ablution (wudu). Then do not reach her until you have performed ablution and prayed two rak'ahs. Then tell them to order her to also pray two rak'ahs.'
Then she should praise God and send blessings upon Muhammad and his family. Then you should supplicate to God, and tell those with her to say 'Ameen' to your supplication.

Then supplicate to God and say: 'O God, grant me her affection, her love, and her pleasure with me, and please me with her, and unite us in the best of unions and the most excellent of affiliations. Indeed, You love the permissible and dislike the forbidden.'
And know that affection (al-ilf) is from God, and separation (al-fark) is from Satan, to make disliked what God, the Mighty and Majestic, has made permissible.'

Ja'far (peace be upon him) from his father from Ali (peace be upon him) said: 'A young girl is not to be consummated with before she is ten years old. If he does so, and she is found to have a defect (or if a defect is found in her), he is liable (for it).'

key_terms.اِلْف: Affection or deep attachment from God

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended ritual and supplication for a groom before consummating the marriage with his new wife?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* outlines the Sunnah of *al-Khalwah* (seclusion) for a groom anxious about his bride's reaction to his appearance, prescribing mutual purification and prayer to invoke divine affection (*al-Ilf*) before consummation. It concludes with a juristic ruling from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (via his father) establishing the minimum age for consummation at ten years, linking failure to comply with legal liability (*daman*).
